newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zairean peace talks in S.Africa adjourn - Mbeki.
newsitem.headline: Zairean peace talks in S.Africa adjourn - Mbeki.

text.p: Zairean peace talks in South Africa adjourned on Tuesday so delegates could consult their leaders, Deputy South African President Thabo Mbeki told reporters.
"A spirit of mutual trust is developing...they are adjourning to allow the parties to consult their principles," Mbeki said.
He said the representatives of President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila had discussed the "timing and modalities" of a cessation of hostilities but needed to consult their leaders.
